title: Arrhenius-Beziehung und lineare Steigung abrufen
titleEn: Recall the Arrhenius relation and linear slope
description: Die lernende Person kann die Arrhenius-Beziehung und die auf der Karte genannte Steigungsbeziehung im ln(k)-gegen-1/T-Modell mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the Arrhenius relation and the slope relation in the ln(k)-versus-1/T model stated on the card using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
